confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on several aggregator price sources (BearSavings, Trek.zone, WhereAndWhen, Citycost, 12go, Tripbase, Sologuides, and a travel blog). Some source dates are unclear, and no current bar or cafe menus were checked. Cocktail and wine_glass have no direct price data, so they are set at about three times the beer anchor, the local price relationship; these are the least certain food values. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no booking pages or current listings were inspected. The FX observation was taken from an rba.gov.au search snapshot and the RBA page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is aggregated Philippine price data, nudged upward for an island tourism destination with imported goods and Western-style cafes. Cocktail and wine are derived from the beer anchor using the local price relationship.
